findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: observe_nip · Private data: observe_nip, unobserve_nip, list_observations, changes_since, set_webhook · Public sink: observe_nip, set_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: observe_nip · Private data: observe_nip, unobserve_nip, list_observations, changes_since, set_webhook · Public sink: observe_nip, set_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
